name: KingsView
tagline: A 3D planning tool that places proposed buildings on a real Kingston map and shows their traffic, emissions and noise impacts.
problem: Residents and planners judge developments from PDFs and guesswork.
solution: Create buildings from specifications or blueprints, place them on a 3D Kingston map, simulate construction over time and visualise impacts on traffic, emissions, noise and air quality, with an environmental report.
demo_moment: Team-described: drop a building onto the map and watch the impact overlays change.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “City of Kingston Prize Track” among 77 submissions.
Links the theme to foresight in city planning.

lessons: Show the trade-off visually and planning becomes something residents can discuss.
